title: GlobalEarthquake
description: Earthquake? Run! Warning will be sent to players if there's an earthquake.
body:
# Global Earthquake（全球地震） 中文版 Global Earthquake (Chinese Version)
_提示：Global Earthquake 仍在测试阶段，可能会出现各种问题_
**在Minecraft服务器中获取最新的地震信息！每当有地震发生时，会向全体玩家发送预警信息**
地震信息来源于中国地震台网。若出现任何问题，请暂时停止使用，并向我们反馈！

## 示例：当地震发生时，您的服务器控制台，以及服务器中的玩家，将收到类似下方示例的信息提示： ![示例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04a5b975373b23332728eda54c169a5e372f5a2e.png)
![示例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a01a86615ade55d2c3877f9900378dd0f6551076.png)
注意：由于网络原因，当有地震发生时，您的服务器可能会在几秒后才会收到预警信息 Global Earthquake (Chinese Version)
**This plugin uses Chinese, so we only suggest using it in Chinese servers.**
Get the latest earthquake information in your Minecraft server! It will send a message to every players if there's an earthquake happened. There may be a slight delay when an earthquake happens, because the connection may be poor sometimes.
作者：Magic_Chicken
Global Earthquake（全球地震）插件仅在Modrinth发布 若发现任何问题，请发送邮件至：**earthquakeminecraft@hotmail.com** By Magic_Chicken
Global Earthquake only released on Modrinth.
